text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One key idea is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so tools can quickly change text from one language into another. Another useful feature is sentiment analysis, which helps computers recognise whether a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way, answering questions and giving helpful information. Thanks to NLP, our daily life with technology is becoming easier and more comfortable.
